function: DRL (modified DDPG plus SAC, MAML meta-learning) configures active STAR-RIS element selection, gain, and phase shifts; BS beamforming and power splitting by convex optimization (pp. 6-10).
system: Downlink MISO: BS with 5 antennas, active STAR-RIS with 16 elements, 3+3 single-antenna SWIPT users; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 11).
method: Alternating optimization; learned part is actor-critic DRL (modified DDPG for discrete selection, SAC for continuous gain/phase), plus MAML meta-learning with meta-training and adaptation phases (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: BS-user links Rayleigh (LoS only); BS-STAR-RIS and STAR-RIS-user links Rician with 5 dB factor; users uniform in 3 m circles; no dataset (p. 11).
test_conditions: Meta-training on Z tasks of random user placements, then meta-adaptation to a new environment; tasks and episodes not reported; sweeps of SINR, EH, elements, users, power (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Own variants only: linear-EH, fixed power splitting 0.5, random phase shifts, passive STAR-RIS, and MDS without meta-learning; no earlier learned method compared (p. 11).
metrics: Average reward and average system energy efficiency versus episodes, minimum harvested power, minimum SINR, number of elements and users, power budgets (pp. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 11: "thus follow the Rician fading with a Rician factor of 5dB" and Rayleigh for BS-user links; a custom simulator, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 9: "to apply a fast adaptability between training and testing environments"; p. 10: "in the meta-adaptation phase, the parameters of the model are initialized using the obtained parameters from the Meta-learning".
q3_support: p. 11: Baseline 3 "are randomized" phase shifts is non-learned, but "Proposed Scheme 1: This baseline adopts Algorithm 2" is the method without meta-learning; no earlier learned method is simulated.
q4_support: p. 2: only "classical convex optimisation-based methods face high computational complexity"; no order, FLOPs, parameters, or runtime is reported for the proposed method.
q5_support: p. 11: "A three-dimensional (3D) coordinate system is considered" with a custom layout and channels; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included: the learned DRL networks configure the active STAR-RIS (element selection, gain, phase shifts), so area 3; BS beamforming and power splitting are solved by convex optimization (Algorithm 1, p. 7), not learned. q2 to confirm: meta-adaptation to a new environment is described (pp. 9-10) and credited for the gains (p. 11, Fig. 2), but tasks are random user placements (p. 9) and the number of tasks, adaptation episodes, and the test setting are not reported; the user-mobility claim on p. 2 has no experiment. q3: the random-phase Baseline 3 is non-learned, but the only learned comparison is the ablation without meta-learning. q4: no complexity analysis anywhere.
